scope: Auditoría estructural de controles visibles en rutas del laboratorio
method: Recorrido Playwright en Edge sobre el build local; comprobación DOM de nombres mediante aria-label, aria-labelledby, labels asociados, texto visible y title. No utiliza axe ni tecnología asistiva.
known_limits: The name check is a DOM-level heuristic, not the browser accessibility tree or WCAG conformance proof.
Screen-reader behavior, full keyboard traversal, and systematic contrast checks remain unverified.
No dependency was added for automated accessibility checks.
